## CHARACTER SHEET

A blank character sheet for recording your character's abilities, skills, feats, and equipment. Print this sheet or use the [interactive character generator](https://engine.moddable.games/play/?game=pathfinder-1e&variant=character-sheet) to create a new character with randomised ability scores and starting gear.
